items.headline: Schedule your most used Copilot prompts
items.summary: Microsoft reveals that scheduled prompts are one of the most practical and underused Copilot features. By scheduling prompts to run automatically on daily, weekly, or monthly cadences, Copilot can surface results when they are needed without manual initiation. The feature is now available across Microsoft 365 apps and allows teams to automate recurring information needs like status reports, data summaries, and analytical queries.
items.levelshiftAngle: Directly applicable to LevelShift's internal Microsoft 365 deployment and client implementations. Our managed services teams supporting Salesforce and D365 clients already handle recurring status reporting and project updates - scheduled Copilot prompts could automate these workflows. Sales enablement opportunity for clients using M365 Copilot as part of our AI Discovery & Assessment Workshops, especially in Manufacturing and Financial Services verticals where recurring compliance and operational reports are standard. Include this in the next AI productivity workshop deck.

items.headline: Salesforce Launches Agentforce Help Agent That Deploys in Minutes and Only Charges for Resolutions
items.summary: Salesforce announced general availability of the Agentforce Help Agent and Customer Service Portal in July 2026. The Help Agent can be set up in 6 clicks or less and works on the new Portal experience or embedded directly on customer websites. Salesforce has simplified pricing to charge only for successful resolutions rather than per conversation, lowering the barrier to autonomous agent deployment for mid-market enterprises.

items.headline: Manufacturing predictive maintenance delivers 12-month payback with 25-30% cost reductions
items.summary: Stanford Digital Economy Lab study of 51 enterprise AI deployments confirms manufacturing predictive maintenance achieves 12-month payback periods and 25-30% reductions in maintenance costs. The research highlights predictive maintenance as one of the fastest-returning AI investments across industries, with one manufacturer reporting 35% reduction in equipment failures and significantly lower emergency repair costs. Results are consistent across manufacturers applying AI to critical production lines.

Add to the Manufacturing practice deck immediately and schedule outreach to existing D365 manufacturing clients to introduce predictive maintenance as Phase 2.

items.headline: Deloitte AI Hallucination Report: FINRA's 2026 Warning
items.summary: Deloitte admitted in July 2026 that it used generative AI to help write a government compliance report that contained fabricated citations, costing the firm 290,000 dollars and triggering FINRA's GenAI compliance crackdown. FINRA's 2026 Annual Regulatory Oversight Report dedicated an entire section to generative AI risks for the first time, explicitly naming hallucinations and bias as risks financial services firms must manage. A 2026 Gartner survey found 67% of enterprises running production RAG systems still experienced at least one hallucination incident in the past year.
items.levelshiftAngle: This is a direct sales enablement asset for LevelShift's Financial Services practice and AI governance consulting. The 5-Phase Value Realization Framework addresses this failure mode explicitly through Controlled Execution (Phase 5) and governance playbooks. Reach out to all Financial Services prospects and existing Salesforce CRM clients (especially those in scope of FINRA or GDPR) with a governance readiness assessment offer. items.headline: EU AI Act becomes fully enforceable August 2 2026 with transparency guidelines published July 20
items.summary: The European Commission published final transparency guidelines on July 20, 2026, 13 days before the EU AI Act becomes fully enforceable on August 2, 2026. The regulation applies to nearly every organization deploying or selling AI systems in the European market, with penalties up to 7% of global revenue for non-compliance. High-risk AI systems must now meet documentation, governance, and testing requirements, with the EU becoming the first jurisdiction in history to impose comprehensive binding regulations on AI.
